name: Euchre
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game where jack bowers are top trumps and side must win three of five tricks.
rules_text: Use 24 cards A-K-Q-J-10-9 in four suits, optionally plus joker as highest trump. Deal five cards each, turn up next card. Clockwise from dealer's left each player may accept turned suit as trump: opponent says order up, dealer's partner says assist, dealer takes it up by discarding. If all pass, dealer turns it down and each player clockwise may name trump other than turned suit or pass. Player who fixes trump may go alone, partner sits out. Play five tricks: leader leads any card, others must follow lead suit if possible else may play trump or discard. Right bower (jack of trump) is highest trump, left bower (jack of same color) second, then A-K-Q-J-10-9 of trump, then other suits A high. Highest trump or highest of lead suit wins trick. Maker scores 1 for 3-4 tricks, 2 for 5; alone scores 1 for 3-4, 4 for 5; if euchred opponents score 2. First to agreed 5,7 or 10 wins.
